tool.name: http_security_headers_audit
tool.description:
Audit HTTP security headers on a single URL — emits one finding per missing / weak header.
Per-host check of the standard security-header set: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options (or CSP frame-ancestors), X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/COEP/CORP, CORS reflection, Set-Cookie security flags, and version disclosure (Server / X-Powered-By).
Severity tuned per real-world impact: - **High** — CORS reflects attacker Origin + `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true` (CWE-942, full cross-origin credentialed access bypass). - **Medium** — missing CSP entirely; session-shaped cookies missing HttpOnly / Secure on HTTPS app. - **Low** — missing HSTS, missing X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors, missing X-Content-Type-Options, missing Referrer-Policy, weak HSTS max-age, weak CSP directives (`unsafe-inline` / `unsafe-eval` / wildcards). - **Info** — missing Permissions-Policy (defense-in-depth); version disclosure (Server / X-Powered-By with version string).
Sends two requests: 1. Plain GET → inspects HSTS / CSP / XFO / XCTO / Referrer-Policy / Permissions-Policy / Server / Set-Cookie flags. 2. GET with `Origin: https://attacker.example.com` → CORS reflection probe.
Each finding includes `description_plain` and `recommended_action` (the §11 non-tech-output fields) so the wrapper's dashboard renders specific fix instructions per header rather than CWE numbers. `fix_time_estimate=5min` on every finding — security headers are pure config-flag fixes.
Composes with cluster-A safety (auth / exclude-path / rate-limit) automatically.
Use after the BFS crawler discovers deep targets — call once per deep host.

parameter.name: target_url
parameter.description: Full URL to audit. The path is not used for header inspection (headers are response-wide), but is preserved on the request so server-side header logic that varies by path is honoured. Plain hostnames get `https://` prefixed automatically.

returns.description:
{success, target_url, is_https, status, header_count, results: [{header, present, value, severity, issue, description?, description_plain?, recommended_action?}], findings_emitted}.
Findings are emitted as side effects via the tracer with category=`security_misconfiguration` and CWE-693 (or CWE-942 for CORS issues).
